visual_inspection.findings: Both final pages read and visually inspected in full. Legible text, formulas and reference; no clipping, overlap, missing glyphs, blank page or orphan reference page. Page1 gives the exact scope, main recurrence, minimality and nondegeneracy; page2 finishes its distance/limit proof, gives the integer supplement, formal verification scope and primary reference.

text_extraction.normalization: Unicode NFKC for typeset ligatures; visual inspection is authoritative for layout.
